candidates.description: The feature vector represents medical conditions, infectious diseases, and associated pharmacological treatments.
These tokens represent common German auxiliary and modal verbs conjugated across various tenses and grammatical numbers.
This feature vector activates on prefixes and root words commonly found in biomedical, chemical, and scientific terminology.
This feature activates on common prefixes and root fragments derived from Latin, Greek, and European languages.
This vector activates on German-language prefixes, compound word roots, and proper noun fragments starting with "Kon".
This vector activates for German verb roots and inflected verb forms.
This feature vector activates strongly on subordinating conjunctions and conditional words across multiple languages.
This vector represents German modal and auxiliary verbs, as well as their common morphological variants and stems.
These tokens represent common German noun and adjective suffixes or suffix-like morphemes associated with abstract nouns and qualifications.
This vector activates strongly on the letter 'l' and common linguistic tokens containing or starting with 'l'.
